Conditioning on the hub, petal colors are independent ordered distinct draws from q−1 remaining colors. Direct character orthogonality yields hub-petal and same-triangle correlation −r, different-triangle r², separating antisymmetric petal, zero-sum symmetric petal, and 2D hub/global-petal sectors. The 2D block [[1,−sqrt(2m)r],[−sqrt(2m)r,1−r+2(m−1)r²]] has determinant S, proving μ± and all multiplicities. q=3 gives S=μ−=0, one relation per triangle and frequency; for q>=4 positivity and extreme eigenvalues μ± imply μ+²/S~4m²r^4/S. The independent color enumeration and Gram Fourier spectra agree for 14 frequency bands.
